wall of ventricular system of brain
wall of ventricular system of brain
wall of ventricular system of brain
wall of ventricular system of brain

label: wall of central canal of spinal cord
wall of ventricular system of brain
wall of heart
definition: Wall of organ which has as its parts the endocardium, myocardium , epicardium, and the cardiac septum, surrounded by the pericardial sac proper and is continuous with the walls of the systemic and pulmonary arterial and venous trees.

label: primary hair
definition: Very thin, soft, usually unpigmented, downy hair that is sometimes found on the body of a fetal or new-born human.

label: vellus hair
definition: Short, thin, slight-colored, and barely noticeable hair that develops on most of a person's body during childhood.

label: terminal hair
definition: Thick and long hair, as compared with vellus hair growing elsewhere.

label: waist
definition: The part of the human abdomen below the ribs and above the hips, often narrower than the areas above and below.

label: paracardial gastric lymph node
definition: Gastric lymph node located around the cardia of stomach.
exactSynonyms: lymph node ring of cardia of stomach

label: subscapular axillary lymph node
definition: An axillary lymph node that is placed along the lower margin of the posterior wall of the axilla in the course of the subscapular artery.

label: pectoral axillary lymph node
definition: An axiallary lymph node along the lower border of the Pectoralis minor, in relation with the lateral thoracic artery. Their afferents drain the skin and muscles of the anterior and lateral thoracic walls, and the central and lateral parts of the mamma; their efferents pass partly to the central and partly to the subclavicular groups of axillary glands.

label: central axillary lymph node
definition: An axillary lymph node that is imbedded in the adipose tissue near the base of the axilla.

label: apical axillary lymph node
definition: An axillary lymph node that is situated partly posterior to the upper portion of the Pectoralis minor and partly above the upper border of this muscle.

label: intermediate mesenteric lymph node
exactSynonyms: intermediate lymph node of small intestine

label: inferior pancreatic lymph node
definition: Pancreaticosplenioc lymph node located along the inferior margin of pancreas.

label: left gastric lymph node
definition: Gastric lymph node located along the lesser curvature of stomach.

label: lateral superior deep cervical lymph node
anterior superior deep cervical lymph node
lateral inferior deep cervical lymph node
anterior inferior deep cervical lymph node
lymph node of inferior pulmonary ligament
superior left gastric lymph node
definition: Left gastric lymph node located along the left gastric artery.

label: inferior left gastric lymph node
definition: Left gastric lymph node located along the cardiac half of the lesser curvature of stomach in the lesser omentum.

label: common hepatic lymph node
definition: Hepatic lymph node located along the common hepatic artery.

label: hepatoportal lymph node
definition: Hepatic lymph node located along the portal vein.

label: proximal superior pancreatic lymph node
definition: Superior pancreatic lymph node located along the proximal segment of splenic artery.

label: distal superior pancreatic lymph node
definition: Superior pancreatic lymph node located along the distal segment of splenic artery.

label: anterior superior pancreaticoduodenal lymph node
definition: Superior pancreaticoduodenal lymph node located on the anterior anterior of superior region of head of pancreas.

label: posterior superior pancreaticoduodenal lymph node
definition: Superior pancreaticoduodenal lymph node located on the posterior aspect of superior portion of head of pancreas.

label: anterior inferior pancreaticoduodenal lymph node
definition: Inferior pancreaticoduodenal lymph node located on the anterior aspect of inferior region of head of pancreas.

label: posterior inferior pancreaticoduodenal lymph node
definition: Inferior pancreaticoduodenal lymph node located on the posterior aspect of inferior region of head of pancreas.

label: visceral pre-aortic lymph node
definition: Intestinal lymph node located anterior to aorta.

label: gastro-epiploic lymph node
definition: Gastric lymph node located along the greater curvature of stomach.
exactSynonyms: lymph node of greater curvature of stomach

label: craniocervical lymph node
definition: Lymph node located in either head and neck region.
exactSynonyms: lymph node of head and neck

label: superior deep lateral cervical lymph node
inferior deep lateral cervical lymph node
suprapyloric lymph node
definition: Pylorioc lymph node located near the bifurcation of gastroduodenal artery and superior to the pylorus.

label: subpyloric lymph node
definition: Pylorioc lymph node located in the angle between the superior and descending parts of duodenum.

label: bronchopulmonary lymph node
definition: A tracheobronchial lymph node situated in the hilum of a lung.

label: anterior intercostal artery
definition: The anterior intercostal branches of internal thoracic artery supply the upper five or six intercostal spaces.
exactSynonyms: intercostal branch of internal thoracic artery

label: mammary branch of internal thoracic artery
exactSynonyms: medial mammary branch of perforating branch of internal thoracic artery

label: accessory vertebral vein
definition: A lower continuation of the vertebral vein and vertebral venous plexus that passes through the foramen of the transverse process of the 7th cervical vertebra and empties into the brachiocephalic vein.

label: anterior vertebral vein
definition: A vein that commences in a plexus around the transverse processes of the upper cervical vertebræ, descends in company with the ascending cervical artery between the Scalenus anterior and Longus capitis muscles, and opens into the terminal part of the vertebral vein.

label: suprascapular vein
definition: The suprascapular vein is a vein running above the scapula. It empties into the external jugular vein.

label: superior laryngeal vein
definition: The superior laryngeal vein is a vein which drains the larynx into the superior thyroid vein.

label: appendicular artery
definition: An artery that commonly arises from the terminal branch of the ileocolic artery, or less commonly from the posterior cecal artery or an ileal artery.[1][2] It descends behind the termination of the ileum and enters the mesoappendix of the vermiform appendix. It runs near the free margin of the mesoappendix and ends in branches which supply the appendix.

label: cystic artery
definition: An artery that supplies oxygenated blood to the cystic duct.

label: prepyloric vein
definition: The prepyloric vein is the last connecting branch onto the right gastric vein, marking the end of the stomach, and draining the proximal part of the duodenum

label: conus artery
definition: The conus artery is generally considered to be the first branch of the right coronary artery (RCA) in the right sinus of Valsalva. However, one study has shown that in approximately 50% of humans, the conus artery arises from a discrete ostium in the right sinus of Valsalva.

label: pubic vein
definition: vein ascending the posterior aspect of the body of the pubis to drain into the inferior epigastric vein; this vein frequently (about 20% of patients) serves as an accessory or replaced obturator vein.
exactSynonyms: pubic branch of inferior epigastric vein

label: rima vulvae
definition: The fissure between the labia majora

label: posterior labial artery
exactSynonyms: posterior labial branch of internal pudendal artery

label: urethral vein
definition: A vein that drains the urethra.

label: Alcock's canal
definition: An anatomical conduit in the pelvis through which the internal pudendal artery, internal pudendal veins, and the pudendal nerve pass.

label: superficial dorsal vein of penis
definition: A vein that drains the prepuce and skin of the penis, and, running backward in the subcutaneous tissue, inclines to the right or left, and opens into the corresponding superficial external pudendal vein, a tributary of the great saphenous vein..

label: first anterior intercostal artery
exactSynonyms: first intercostal branch of internal thoracic artery

label: second anterior intercostal artery
exactSynonyms: second intercostal branch of internal thoracic artery

label: third anterior intercostal artery
exactSynonyms: third intercostal branch of internal thoracic artery

label: fourth anterior intercostal artery
exactSynonyms: fourth intercostal branch of internal thoracic artery

label: fifth anterior intercostal artery
exactSynonyms: fifth intercostal branch of internal thoracic artery

label: sixth anterior intercostal artery
exactSynonyms: sixth intercostal branch of internal thoracic artery

label: left anterior segmental artery
exactSynonyms: anterior bronchopulmonary segment of left pulmonary artery
anterior segmental artery of left lung
anterior segmental artery of left upper lobe

label: apicoposterior segmental artery
exactSynonyms: apicoposterior bronchopulmonary segment of left pulmonary artery

label: right ovarian vein
definition: Ovarian vein, each instance of which is a tributary  of some inferior vena cava that drains the right pampiniform plexus of some broad ligament.

label: left ovarian vein
definition: Ovarian vein, each instance of which is a tributary  of some left renal vein that drains the left pampiniform plexus of some broad ligament.

label: labial commissure
definition: Anatomical structure consisting of either corner of the mouth.

label: top of head
definition: The top of the head.

label: skin of face
definition: A zone of skin that is part of the face.

label: spleen pulp
definition: The parenchyma of the spleen, consisting of lymphocytes and macrophages. It lies between the splenic trabecula. Red pulp is the part suffused with blood and white pulp consists of areas of lymphatic tissue where there are sleeves of lymphocytes and macrophages.

label: parenchyma of spleen
definition: A parenchyma that is part of a spleen.

label: ileocecal fold
definition: A fold of peritoneum between the ileum and cecum. The upper border of the ileocecal fold is fixed to the ileum opposite its mesenteric attachment, and the lower border passes over the ileocecal junction to join the mesentery of the appendix (and sometimes the appendix itself as well). Behind the ileocecal fold is the inferior ileocecal fossa.

label: continuous capillary
definition: Capillary that has endothelial cells that provide an uninterrupted lining, and only allow small molecules, like water and ions to diffuse through tight junctions which leave gaps of unjoined membrane which are called intercellular clefts.

label: fenestrated capillary
definition: Capillary that has pores in the endothelial cells (60-80 nm in diameter) that are spanned by a diaphragm of radially oriented fibrils and allow small molecules and limited amounts of protein to diffuse.

label: episcleral vein
definition: A vein located between the bulbar conjunctiva and the sclera.

label: skin of scalp
definition: A zone of skin that is part of a scalp.
exactSynonyms: zone of skin of adult scalp

label: right forelimb
definition: A forelimb that is on the right side of a pectoral complex.

label: left forelimb
definition: A forelimb that is on the left side of a pectoral complex.

label: right hindlimb
definition: A hindlimb that is on the right side of a pelvic complex.

label: left hindlimb
definition: A hindlimb that is on the left side of a pelvic complex.

label: duodeno-jejunal junction
definition: The anatomical junction between the duodenum and the jejunum.

label: fimbria of fallopian tube
definition: A fringe of tissue around the ostium of the fallopian tube, in the direction of the ovary.

label: left colic vein
definition: A portal vein that drains the descending colon. It is a tributary of the inferior mesenteric vein, and follows the path of its corresponding artery, the left colic artery.

label: right colic vein
definition: A portal vein that drains the ascending colon. It is a tributary of the superior mesenteric vein, and travels with its corresponding artery, the right colic artery.

label: left colic artery
definition: The first branch of the inferior mesenteric artery (IMA) is the left colic artery. The left colic artery supplies blood flow to the distal third of the transverse colon and the entirety of the descending colon. Once diverging from the IMA, the left colic artery runs anterior to the left ureter, left internal spermatic vessels (males), and psoas major before branching into its ascending and descending segments.

label: right colic artery
definition: The right colic artery may arise directly from the superior mesenteric artery (SMA) but often arises from a common trunk with the ileocolic artery or middle colic artery. It supplies the ascending colon.

label: levator costarum
definition: A chest muscle with a role in forceful inspiration. In human, there are twelve levatores costarum on either side of the chest; they are small tendinous and fleshy bundles arising from the ends of the transverse processes of the seventh cervical and upper eleven thoracic vertebrae. They pass obliquely downward and laterally, like the fibers of the intercostales externi, and each is inserted into the outer surface of the rib immediately below the vertebra from which it takes origin, between the tubercle and the angle (levatores costarum breves). Each of the four lower muscles divides into two fasciculi, one of which is inserted as above described; the other passes down to the second rib below its origin (levatores costarum longi).

label: right lymphatic duct
definition: A great lymphatic vessel that empties lymph into one of the subclavian veins. In humans, there are two lymph ducts in the body: the right lymphatic duct and the thoracic duct. The right lymphatic duct drains lymph from the right upper limb, right side of thorax and right halves of head and neck. The thoracic duct drains lymph into the circulatory system at the left brachiocephalic vein between the left subclavian and left internal jugular veins.

label: ethmoidal vein
definition: A vein that accompanies an ethmoidal artery and drains the ethmoidal cells.

label: anterior ethmoidal vein
definition: An ethmoidal vein that accompanies an anterior ethmoidal artery. The anterior ethmoidal vein normally drains into the inferior root of the superior ophthalmic vein.

label: posterior ethmoidal vein
definition: An ethmoidal vein that accompanies a posterior ethmoidal artery. The posterior ethmoidal vein often drains into a venous network under the orbital roof.

label: subiliac lymph node
definition: A lymph node located inferior to the ilium.

label: calf
definition: The posterior aspect of the lower extremity that extends from the knee to the foot.

label: front hindlimb zeugopod
definition: The frontal aspect of the lower extremity that extends from the knee to the foot.

label: skin of calf
definition: Skin of the back of the lower leg.
exactSynonyms: skin of posterior part of leg

label: lateral wall of urinary bladder
definition: A wall of the urinary bladder that is situated on the sides or flanks.

label: left lateral wall of urinary bladder
definition: A lateral wall of the urinary bladder that is located on the left side.

label: right lateral wall of urinary bladder
definition: A lateral wall of the urinary bladder that is located on the right side.

label: anterior wall of urinary bladder
definition: The most anterior wall of the urinary bladder.

label: posterior wall of urinary bladder
definition: The most posterior wall of the urinary bladder.

label: apex of urinary bladder
definition: The anterior angle of the superior surface of the urinary bladder. The apex of urinary bladder is connected to the umbilicus by the urachus in embryos, and by the median umbilical ligament, a remnant of urachus, in adults.

label: dome of urinary bladder
definition: The anterosuperior surface of the urinary bladder, with boundaries at the apex and fundus of the urinary bladder.

label: segmental pulmonary vein
definition: A vein that is tributary of the main pulmonary veins and drains oxygenated blood from a segment of the lung.

label: subsegmental pulmonary vein
definition: A vein that is tributary of the segmental pulmonary veins and drains oxygenated blood from a subsegment of the lung.

label: esophageal vein
definition: A vein that is tributary of the azygos vein and drains blood from the esophagus.

label: supreme intercostal vein
definition: A vein that is tributary of the superior intercostal vein and drains the first intercostal space.

label: atrioventricular nodal artery
definition: An artery that branches from the right coronary artery and supplies the atrioventricular node.
exactSynonyms: atrioventricular node branch of right coronary artery

label: lateral sacral vein
definition: A vein that is tributary of the internal iliac vein and drains the anterior surface of the sacrum.

label: middle hemorrhoidal vein
definition: A vein that is tributary of the internal iliac vein.

label: uterine vein
definition: A vein that is tributary of the internal iliac vein and drains the uterus.

label: deep cervical vein
definition: A vein that is tributary of a vertebral vein and drains the suboccipital region, adjacent vertebral column, and deep muscles of the neck.

label: subsegmental pulmonary artery
definition: An artery that is a branch of the segmental pulmonary artery and supplies deoxyge blood to a smaller subsegment of the lung.

label: thyrocervical trunk
definition: An artery that branches from the subclavian artery and supplies the thyroid gland, neck, and upper back regions.

label: lateral femoral circumflex vein
definition: A vein that is tributary of the femoral vein and drains blood from the front and middle areas of the thigh.
exactSynonyms: set of lateral circumflex femoral veins

label: basivertebral vein
definition: A vein that is tributary of the anterior internal vertebral venous plexus and drains blood from the vertebral bodies.

label: deep lingual vein
definition: A vein that is tributary of the lingual vein and drains blood from the tongue.

label: dorsal lingual vein
definition: A vein that is tributary of the lingual vein and drains blood from the dorsum of the tongue, and the sides of the tongue.

label: sublingual vein
definition: A vein that is tributary of the lingual vein and drains blood from the ventral (inferior) surface of the tongue and the sublingual glands.

label: thoracoacromial vein
definition: A vein that is tributary of the axillary vein and drains blood from the thoracoacromial region, including the pectoral, shoulder, and clavicular regions.

label: transverse cervical vein
definition: A vein that is tributary of the external jugular vein and drains blood from the superficial muscles of the back, mainly the trapezius muscle.

label: suboccipital venous plexus
definition: A venous plexus that is tributary of the deep cervical veins and drains blood from the suboccipital region.

label: pulmonary arteriole
definition: An arteriole that branches from the pulmonary arteries and supplies deoxygenated blood to the pulmonary capillaries and alveolar capillaries of the lungs.

label: ascending pharyngeal artery
definition: An artery of the neck that branches from the external carotid artery and supplies the pharynx.

label: pericardial artery
definition: An artery that branches from the descending thoracic aorta and supplies the dorsal portion of the pericardium.

label: percardiacophrenic artery
definition: An artery that branches from the internal thoracic artery and supplies the pericardium and the diaphragm.

label: superficial iliac circumflex vein
definition: A vein that is tributary of the great saphenous vein and drains blood from the inguinal region and the anterior abdominal wall.

label: fibular vein
definition: A vein that is tributary of the posterior tibial vein and drains blood from the lateral compartment of the leg.

label: external nasal vein
definition: A vein that is tributary of the angular vein and drains blood from the superficial tissues and skin of the dorsum (bridge) and ala (wings) of the nose.

label: supratrochlear vein
definition: A vein that is tributary of the angular vein and drains blood from the muscles and skin of the forehead.

label: inferior anastomotic vein
definition: A vein that is tributary of the transverse sinus and drains blood from the adjacent cortical regions of the temporal lobe. The inferior anastomotic vein forms an anastomosis (connection) between the superficial middle cerebral vein anteriorly and the transverse sinus posteriorly.

label: radial vein
definition: A vein that is tributary of the brachial vein and drains blood from the lateral structures of the forearm, carpal and metacarpal bones, joints of the hand, and lateral forearm muscles.

label: ulnar vein
definition: A vein that is tributary of the brachial vein and drains blood from the hand and medial and posterior aspect of forearm.

label: ascending palatine artery
definition: An artery that branches from the facial artery, and branches to supply the soft palate and the palatine tonsil.

label: submental artery
definition: An artery that branches from the facial artery that runs forward under the mouth, then turns upward upon reaching the chin.

label: deep lingual artery
definition: An artery that branches from the lingual artery and supplies blood to the tongue itself, particularly the body and tip of the tongue. The deep lingual artery travels superiorly in a tortuous course along the under (ventral) surface of the tongue, below the longitudinalis inferior, and above the mucous membrane.

label: dorsal lingual artery
definition: An artery that branches from the lingual artery and supplies the soft palate, tonsils, epiglottis, palatoglossal arch, and adjacent mucous membrane. The dorsal lingual artery runs along the upper border of the hyoid bone and anastomises with its fellow of the opposite side.

label: accessory meningeal artery
definition: An artery that branches from the maxillary artery and supplies the meninges. The accessory meningeal artery ascends through the foramen ovale to enter the cranial cavity and supply the dura mater of the floor of the middle cranial fossa and of the trigeminal cave, and to the trigeminal ganglion.

label: artery of pterygoid canal
definition: An artery that branches from the maxillary artery and supplies blood to structures in the auditory tube, tympanic cavity, and upper pharynx. The artery of the pterygoid canal courses through the pterygoid canal, a small bony canal located in the sphenoid bone of the skull.

label: descending palatine artery
definition: An artery that branches from the maxillary artery and supplies the hard and soft palate.

label: left anterior descending artery
definition: An artery that branches from the left coronary artery and supplies the anterior wall of the left ventricle, the interventricular septum, and the apex of the heart.
exactSynonyms: anterior interventricular branch of left coronary artery

label: anterior internal vertebral venous plexus
definition: A venous plexus that is tributary of the basivertebral veins and internal vertebral veins, draining blood from the vertebrae and spinal cord. The anterior internal vertebral venous plexus is located within the vertebral canal.

label: intervertebral vein
definition: A vein that drains blood from the vertebral column and intervertebral discs. In the neck, it is tributary of into the vertebral veins. In the thorax, it is tributary of the posterior intercostal veins. In the lumbar and sacral regions, it is tributary of the lumbar and lateral sacral veins

label: lumbar vein
definition: A vein that is tributary of the inferior vena cava and drains blood from the posterior abdominal wall and lumbar region.

label: anterior humeral circumflex artery
definition: An artery that branches from the axilliary artery and supplies the deltoid, biceps brachii, and coracobrachialis muscles, the glenohumeral joint, the proximal humeral head, and the skin overlying the anterior aspect of the proximal humerus. This artery courses laterally across the anterior surface of the humerus and anastomoses with the posterior humeral circumflex artery.

label: posterior humeral circumflex artery
definition: An artery that branches from the axilliary artery and supplies the deltoid, teres major, teres minor, and long and lateral heads of the triceps brachii muscles, glenohumeral joint, and the cutaneous supply to the area posterolateral to the proximal humerus. This artery courses posteriorly with the axillary nerve, through the quadrangular space, to the posterior aspect of the humerus and anastomoses with the anterior humeral circumflex artery.

label: proximal ureter
definition: A segment of the ureter that extends from the renal pelvis to the common iliac artery bifurcation (to form the internal and external iliac arteries).

label: distal ureter
definition: A segment of the ureter that extends from the common iliac artery bifurcation to the bladder. From there, the ureter curves back and follows the lateral pelvic wall inferiorly to connect with the posterolateral bladder wall.

label: intramural ureter
definition: The terminal segment of the ureter that is continuous with the distal ureter, lies where the ureter enters the bladder and extends within the bladder wall. The intramural ureter is aperistaltic, serving as a reflux-preventing mechanism, preventing the backflow of urine from the bladder into the ureters.

label: right distal ureter
definition: A distal ureter that is part of the right ureter.

label: left distal ureter
definition: A distal ureter that is part of the left ureter.

label: right proximal ureter
definition: A proximal ureter that is part of the right ureter.

label: left proximal ureter
definition: A proximal ureter that is part of the left ureter.

label: lumbar ganglion
definition: A ganglion that is part of the lumbar portion of the sympathetic trunk. The neurons in a lumbar ganglion are postganglionic sympathetic neurons that synapse with axons from preganglionic sympathetic neurons.

label: sacral ganglion
definition: A ganglion that is part of the sacral portion of the sympathetic trunk. A sacral ganglion consists of postganglionic sympathetic neurons that receive presynaptic input from preganglionic sympathetic axons descending through the sympathetic trunk from thoracolumbar levels.

label: lumen of pulmonary alveolus
definition: An anatomical cavity that is part of the alveolus of the lung

label: anterior ciliary artery
definition: An artery that branches from the ophthalmic artery and supplies the anterior segment of the eyeball and ciliary body.

label: short posterior ciliary artery
definition: An artery that branches from the ophthalmic artery and supplies the choroid and ciliary processes.
exactSynonyms: Set of short posterior ciliary arteries

label: long posterior ciliary artery
definition: An artery that branches from the ophthalmic artery and supplies the choroid, ciliary body and iris.
exactSynonyms: Set of long posterior ciliary arteries

label: right marginal artery
definition: An artery that is a branch of the right coronary artery. It follows the acute margin of the heart supplying blood to the right ventricle.
exactSynonyms: Marginal branch of right coronary artery

label: segmental renal artery
definition: An artery that branches from the renal artery. The anterior division of the renal artery typically divides into four segmental arteries, whereas the posterior division of the renal artery supplies one segmental artery.

label: superior segmental renal artery
definition: A segmental renal artery that passes anterior to the renal pelvis, superiorly and laterally. It supplies the superior (apical) lobe of the kidney.

label: anterior superior segmental renal artery
definition: A segmental renal artery that passes anterior to the renal pelvis, superiorly and laterally towards the superior pole of the kidney. It does not ascend as steeply as the superior segmental artery and does not extend into the superior pole. It supplies the anterosuperior lobe of the kidney, which includes the central anterosuperior region, extending to the lateral aspect and slightly onto the posterior surface of the kidney.

label: anterior inferior segmental renal artery
definition: A segmental renal artery that passes anterior to the renal pelvis, laterally and angled slightly inferiorly. It supplies the anteroinferior lobe of the kidney, which includes the central anteroinferior region, extending to the lateral aspect and slightly onto the posterior surface of the kidney.

label: inferior segmental renal artery
definition: A segmental renal artery that passes anterior to the renal pelvis, inferiorly and laterally towards the inferior pole of the kidney. It supplies the inferior lobe of the kidney, which encompasses the whole of the inferior pole of the kidney, including the anterior and posterior surfaces.

label: posterior segmental renal artery
definition: A segmental renal artery that passes posterior to the renal pelvis and travels laterally, more or less horizontally. It supplies the posterior lobe of the kidney, which includes all of the central-posterior surface of the kidney. This excludes the superior and inferior poles and a small posterolateral portion.

label: left marginal vein
definition: A vein that is a tributary of the great cardiac vein (left coronary vein) and drains blood from the left ventricle of the heart. It courses with the left marginal artery as it travels superiorly along the left cardiac border.

label: stellate vein of kidney
definition: A vein that drains blood from the most superficial zones of the renal cortex. Groups of stellate veins are arranged in a star-like pattern, converging centrally to drain into an interlobular vein.
exactSynonyms: Set of stellate veins of kidney

label: anterior ciliary vein
definition: A vein that is a tributary of the superior ophthalmic vein and drains blood from the ciliary body of the eye.

label: left bronchial vein
definition: A bronchial vein that drains blood from the bronchi into the accessory hemiazygos vein or the left superior intercostal vein.

label: right bronchial vein
definition: A bronchial vein that drains blood from the bronchi into the azygos vein.

label: right inferior pulmonary vein
definition: A pulmonary vein that drains blood from the inferior lobe of the right lung.

label: left inferior pulmonary vein
definition: A pulmonary vein that drains blood from the inferior lobe of the left lung.

label: right superior pulmonary vein
definition: A pulmonary vein that drains blood from the superior and middle lobes of the right lung.

label: left superior pulmonary vein
definition: A pulmonary vein that drains blood from the superior lobe and lingula of the left lung.

label: dorsal pancreatic artery
definition: An artery that branches from the splenic artery and supplies the head, uncinate process, neck, body and tail of the pancreas. It anastamoses with the superior pancreaticoduodenal artery.
exactSynonyms: Dorsal pancreatic part of splenic artery

label: greater pancreatic artery
definition: An artery that branches from the splenic artery and supplies the left half of the body and tail of the pancreas.

label: caudal pancreatic artery
definition: An artery that branches from the splenic artery and supplies the tail of the pancreas.

label: anterior superior pancreaticoduodenal artery
definition: An artery that branches from the gastroduodenal artery and supplies the first and second parts (superior and descending parts) of the duodenum and the head of the pancreas.

label: posterior superior pancreaticoduodenal artery
definition: An artery that branches from the gastroduodenal artery and supplies the first and second parts of the duodenum, distal common bile duct and head of the pancreas.

label: anterior inferior pancreaticoduodenal artery
definition: An artery that branches from the inferior pancreaticoduodenal artery. It courses on the anterior surface of the uncinate process continuing on to the head of the pancreas. It supplies the uncinate process, head of the pancreas, and the second and third parts of the duodenum.

label: posterior inferior pancreaticoduodenal artery
definition: An artery that branches from the inferior pancreaticoduodenal artery. It courses posterior to the uncinate process and head of the pancreas. It supplies uncinate process and head of the pancreas, second and third parts of the duodenum.

label: anterior cecal artery
definition: An artery that branches from the ileocolic artery and supplies the anterior portion of the cecum.

label: posterior cecal artery
definition: An artery that branches from the ileocolic artery and supplies the posterior portion of the cecum.

label: marginal artery of Drummond
definition: An arterial arcade that connects the superior and inferior mesenteric arteries and supplies the colon.

label: ascending branch of left colic artery
definition: An artery that branches from the left colic artery and supplies the superior portion of the descending colon, the left colic flexure, and the right one half to one third of the transverse colon.

label: descending branch of left colic artery
definition: An artery that branches from the left colic artery and supplies the inferior portion of the descending colon.

label: left artery of caudate lobe
definition: An artery that branches from the left hepatic artery and supplies the medial portion of the caudate lobe of the liver.
exactSynonyms: Caudate lobe branch of left hepatic artery

label: right artery of caudate lobe
definition: An artery that branches from the right hepatic artery and supplies the lateral portion of the caudate lobe of the liver.
exactSynonyms: Caudate lobe branch of right hepatic artery

label: ileal branch of ileocolic artery
definition: An artery that branches from the ileocolic artery and supplies the distal most ileum, ileocecal junction, cecum and appendix.
exactSynonyms: Ileal branch of inferior branch of ileocolic artery

label: retroduodenal artery
definition: An artery that branches from the gastroduodenal artery and supplies the posterior surface of the proximal duodenum.

label: supraduodenal artery
definition: An artery that branches from the gastroduodenal artery and supplies the superior, right, and anterior surfaces of the first part of the duodenum, extending into the second part.

label: right gastric artery
definition: An artery that branches from the proper hepatic artery and supplies the right side of the lesser curvature of the stomach and adjacent anterior and posterior surfaces.

label: short gastric artery
definition: An artery that branches from the splenic artery and supplies the fundus of the stomach on the side of the greater curvature of the stomach.

label: left gastroepiploic vein
definition: A vein that is a tributary of the splenic vein and drains the anterior and posterior body of the stomach and greater omentum.

label: right gastroepiploic vein
definition: A vein that is a tributary of the superior mesenteric vein and drains the greater omentum and distal body and antrum of the stomach.

label: esophageal branches of left gastric artery
definition: An artery that branches from the left gastric artery and supplies the abdominal esophagus.
exactSynonyms: Esophageal part of left gastric artery

label: posterior scrotal artery
definition: An artery that branches from the internal pudendal artery and supplies the scrotum.

label: vaginal artery
definition: An artery that branches from the internal iliac artery and supplies the lower vagina and fundus of the bladder.

label: superior rectal vein
definition: A vein that is a tributary of the inferior mesenteric vein and drains the upper two thirds of the rectum and upper anal canal.

label: inferior rectal vein
definition: A vein that is a tributary of the internal pudendal vein and drains the lower third of the rectum and anal canal.

label: posterior scrotal vein
definition: A vein that is a tributary of the internal pudendal vein and drains the skin and fascial layers of the posterior scrotum.

label: inner cortex of lens
definition: A zone of the lens cortex that lies immediately external to the lens nucleus and internal to the outer cortex of lens. It is composed of older, fully denucleated lens fibre cells whose lamellae remain largely intact but which are more compacted than those of the outer cortex.

label: outer cortex of lens
definition: A zone of the lens cortex that lies immediately beneath the lens capsule and epithelium and surrounds the inner cortex of lens. It is composed of the most recently differentiated lens fibre cells, added from the lens epithelium at the equator; it contains the remodelling and transition zones in which fibre cells lose their nuclei.

label: basement membrane of fallopian tube isthmus
definition: An acellular membrane that is part of the epithelium of the isthmus of the fallopian tube, lying adjacent to the epithelial cells between the epithelial layer and the underlying lamina propria.

label: inner muscle layer of fallopian tube infundibulum
definition: An organ component layer composed primarily of circularly arranged smooth muscle tissue that forms the innermost layer of the muscular coat of the uterine tube infundibulum, contributing to peristaltic contractions that assist in gamete and embryo transport.

isA.targetLabel: circular muscle layer of muscular coat

relations.targetLabel: muscle layer of infundibulum of uterine tube

label: lamina propria of fallopian tube intramural segment
definition: A lamina propria that forms the connective tissue layer beneath the epithelium in the mucosa of the intramural segment of the fallopian tube, which is the portion of the uterine tube that passes through the wall of the uterus.

label: muscle layer of fallopian tube isthmus
definition: A muscular coat that is part of the isthmus of the fallopian tube, consisting of outer longitudinal and inner circular layers of smooth muscle that are responsible for peristaltic contractions propelling the ovum toward the uterus.

label: outer muscle layer of fallopian tube infundibulum
definition: An organ component layer composed primarily of longitudinally arranged smooth muscle tissue that forms the outermost layer of the muscular coat of the uterine tube infundibulum, contributing to peristaltic contractions that assist in gamete and embryo transport.

isA.targetLabel: longitudinal muscle layer of muscular coat

relations.targetLabel: muscle layer of infundibulum of uterine tube

label: serosa of fallopian tube isthmus
definition: A serous membrane that forms the outermost layer of the isthmus of the fallopian tube, derived from the visceral peritoneum.
